//: Editor Pyright config. Must live at the workspace root — Pyright does not read pyrightconfig.json from subdirectories, and venvPath/venv are global-only settings that cannot be set per executionEnvironment (docs/configuration.md). Two independent Python packages (utils/dndsim, utils/wiki-cli) each have their own .venv; only one can be the global venvPath/venv, so the other resolves third-party imports via its own executionEnvironment's extraPaths pointing straight at its venv's site-packages instead. Authoritative type checking is mypy, run by pre-commit; this exists so the editor agrees with it.
